Two rotations with the same two members, alice and bob, and a mutual `repel primary, secondary` row in `#Global`, so normally the two alternate in opposite phase. In `secondary`, bob is excluded for two weeks from 2026-09-21. On 09-21 `primary` has alice and `secondary` has only alice left, so the repel cannot be honoured: `min_distance` is 0 and cannot be relaxed further, so the repel is dropped and alice takes the `secondary` week with the note `repel relaxed: alice also on primary`, which also appears as a warning in `#Status` (`expected/status.txt`). On 09-28 `primary` has bob, so alice is a regular choice for `secondary` without any note, and from 10-05 the alternation resumes. Exclusions are never relaxed, which is why alice rather than bob covers 09-21.
